description: A Compare frame encoded by Python's struct module, independently of both implementations. Mode 1 is raw; flags 40 is synced (8) and compared (32); views 0 and laneCount 3: this track, one other track and the sum of the compared tracks follow the 84-byte header, in the order of the lanes message with laneSet 42, then one match per track. This track's match is none: no correlation or offset (NaN, written "NaN" here) and polarity 0; the other track correlates at -0.75 and lags by 62.5 samples with opposite polarity (-1). The sum is 6.5 dB below unrelated, 2.75 dB above with the fix. The left edge is 8 s into the project. No frequency was found (NaN). Lane 1 holds samples that are not finite (invalidLanes 2). The audio is at 48 kHz (sampleRate 48000). A tempo-synced sweep has no Seconds span (spanSeconds 0).
